values.note: $22 a night (recreation.gov peak season, the same in 2026, 2027 and 2028). Fees are for the full-service summer period; in early spring and late fall some areas charge none. Boat landing day use $5 a vehicle ($30 season pass), waived for registered campers.

values.note: 20 drive-in sites in one loop for tents, trailers and motor homes (18 back-in, 2 pull-through); no lengths in the catalog. Eight people and 2 motorized vehicles per site, at most one RV or trailer.

values.note: From October 15 no water or garbage service; the campground can be used until snow limits access.

values.note: 12 of the 20 sites are reservable on recreation.gov, up to 4 days before arrival; the other 8 are first-come. Reservations run through September 30; October 1-15 every site is first-come self-registration. recreation.gov marks a 4-night minimum as 'soft': it may be relaxed for a same-day booking. 14-day limit, then move at least 24 hours; the site must be occupied the first night. Run by a concessionaire (Camp Host, LLC).

From 10/1 - 10/15/2026 sites are first-come, first-served self-registration.'; 'Contact Name: Camp Host, LLC'), read 2026-10-25

note: Ottawa NF campground on 994-acre Perch Lake, Kenton Ranger District, 10 mi SE of Sidnaw via Sidnaw Road (paved about 6.5 mi, then gravel). One loop of spacious sites, many with lake access. Concrete boat ramp and trailer parking adjacent; popular for canoeing, kayaking and deep-woods fishing; Hannah-Web and Winslow lakes a few minutes west. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + RIDB catalog + FS page (updated 2026-05-05): $22 (2026-2028, confirmed), no electric / no sewer (confirmed), 20 sites (confirmed) with 2 pull-throughs, vault toilets and hand-pump water (new), season May 15 - Oct 15 (new), 14-day limit (new), senior/access passes (now stated). Booking: 12 reservable / 8 first-come (fcfs after_cutoff -> some_sites), 4-day cutoff, reservations through Sept 30 then first-come Oct 1-15, and a 4-night 'soft' minimum recorded. Run by Camp Host, LLC. No Ottawa NF alert or order affects Sidnaw Road (the Oct 9-10 rally closures near Kenton are past). Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Standing minimum: recreation.gov's facility rules carry minConsecutiveStay 4 nights marked 'soft' (no weekend/holiday rule), i.e. a 4-night minimum on reservations at all times; 8 of the 20 sites are first-come and all are first-come Oct 1-15. Recorded in booking.min_stay; a 3+-night standing minimum is a drop candidate (memory feedback_minimum_stay) - for AWH to decide.
